data.title: Skeuomorphism
data.tagline: Use familiar real-world form and material to explain a digital control
data.description: Skeuomorphism makes digital objects resemble physical ones through shape, texture, light, and behavior. It can make an unfamiliar interaction easier to understand or give a focused experience character. Literal leather, wood, and metal on every surface quickly add noise and age poorly.

use: A focused control with a useful physical analogy
Brand experiences built around craft or material
avoid: Cover an entire work tool in decorative textures
Copy a physical limitation that makes the digital task slower
Use realistic shading without clear interaction states
Assume a physical reference is familiar to every audience

data.agentPrompt: Focused skeuomorphic interface with one useful physical analogy, internally consistent material and lighting, stitched leather or linen used sparingly, glossy controls with clear labels, realistic but restrained shadows
